title: The raw DRILLTHROUGH row cap fails closed: statements the clamp cannot prove bounded are refused with a typed 4xx, and the emitted cap is verified by Mondrian's real parser

criteria.given: a raw DRILLTHROUGH statement the cap cannot turn into a provably bounded statement (unterminated leading comment, comments with no locatable keyword, a MAXROWS/FIRST_ROWSET clause with a missing, non-positive or unparseable bound)
criteria.then: capRawDrillthrough refuses it with SaikuQueryRejectedException — it is never returned uncapped and never papered over with a second MAXROWS (which was a guaranteed parse error)

criteria.given: the two raw drillthrough call sites (ThinQueryService and OlapQueryService) that execute client-assembled DRILLTHROUGH MDX
criteria.then: the capped statement is re-parsed with Mondrian's REAL parser (RolapConnection.parseStatement) before execution and must yield a DrillThrough whose MAXROWS bound sits in [1, QueryGuardrails.maxRows()]; anything else is a typed rejection

plain, /*a*/-, --x\n- and //x\n-prefixed raw DRILLTHROUGH bodies return at most 5 rows on POST /api/query/execute and POST /api/notebooks/run (the behavioural IT, DrillthroughRowCapIT, ships with the fix)
it asserts the fail-closed result (a typed rejection), not the fail-open pass-through

criteria.given: a raw DRILLTHROUGH whose MAXROWS clause Mondrian would read as absent or non-positive — MAXROWS 0 (UNLIMITED to Mondrian), or a clause with no readable bound
criteria.then: the request never 500s on a double-MAXROWS parse error and never executes unbounded: a bound Mondrian accepts but the cap cannot prove is refused with the typed 4xx (fixed, information-free message), and a terminated comment inside the clause carrying a valid bound is simply capped

criteria.given: the regression and property tests for C1, C2 and C3
